Prior appointments mandatory for all DMT Narahenpita services from November 23

cards.what_happened: The Department of Motor Traffic will require prior appointments for all public services at its Narahenpita Head Office starting November 23, 2026. Daily appointment slots have been more than doubled to serve more people faster. People can book by phone or online and are asked not to queue outside early in the morning.
details: The Department of Motor Traffic announced that from November 23, 2026, all public services at the Narahenpita Head Office will be provided only through a prior appointment system. Members of the public must book a date and time in advance. The department has increased daily appointment slots by more than double to handle more service seekers and ensure faster, more convenient delivery.

You can book an appointment by calling 011 2 117 116 or by visiting the department's online booking portal at https://dmtappointments.dmt.gov.lk. The public is urged not to queue unnecessarily outside the office from early morning beginning on that date. The Commissioner General of Motor Traffic, retired Air Vice Marshal Thushara Fernando, explained that the new system aims to improve public convenience and reduce waiting times.
He asked everyone seeking services at the Narahenpita Head Office to book ahead so they do not face inconvenience. The announcement came from Newswire.
cards.why_it_matters: The new appointment system is intended to improve public convenience and minimise waiting times at the Narahenpita Head Office.
key_facts: DMT requires prior appointments for all Narahenpita Head Office services from November 23, 2026.
Daily appointment slots increased by more than double.
Book by calling 011 2 117 116 or using the online portal.
Public told not to queue outside early in the morning from November 23.
Commissioner General is retired Air Vice Marshal Thushara Fernando.
System aims to improve convenience and reduce waiting times.
cards.whats_next: The prior appointment system starts at the Narahenpita Head Office on November 23, 2026.
cards.blurb: From November 23, 2026, you need an appointment for all DMT services at Narahenpita Head Office.
cards.spoken: Hello and good day. If you need to visit the Department of Motor Traffic office in Narahenpita, you will now have to book ahead. Starting on November 23, 2026, every public service at that head office will be available only through a prior appointment. You can reserve your date and time by calling 011 2 117 116 or by going online to the department's booking portal. The department has more than doubled the number of daily slots so more people can be served faster. Officials are asking everyone not to line up outside early in the morning anymore. Retired Air Vice Marshal Thushara Fernando, the Commissioner General of Motor Traffic, says this change will make things more convenient and cut waiting times. He encourages everyone to book in advance to avoid any trouble.
cards.person: retired Air Vice Marshal Thushara Fernando
